title: The $12 operator seat add-on is removed from the catalog, checkout, billing page, pricing surfaces and admin console

source.ref: Owner ruling 2026-10-19 20:00Z: Remove the $12 operator completely. That was an OLD plan that snuck back in.

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-19 (ADR-1810). PREMISE RE-TESTED on main: operator_seat was a live $12/seat/mo catalog item, catalogKeysForLoadout added it to every paid plan's checkout when a seat count was passed, Go Business carried a seat picker, the billing page a seat editor with proration, the admin console an activation switch, and /pricing, the page template, the FAQ, llms.txt and the comparison disclaimer all quoted a per-seat price while the space_team meter already includes seats on every tier. Removed: the catalog item (now in RETIRED_CATALOG_ITEM_KEYS so legacy rows resolve and the sync mints nothing), seatQuantity and operatorSeatsSellable from the loadout checkout, lib/billing/operator-seats.ts, the seat editor, setOperatorSeats, the picker, the grid row and extras card, the seats FAQ (now reads the included counts off PLACEHOLDER_METER_LIMITS), the template card, the llms line, the admin row and the catalog_operator_seat_active flag. Kept: seatQuantityFromItems in the reconciler, so a grandfathered subscription keeps its seats.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const r=(p)=>fs.existsSync(p)?fs.readFileSync(p,'utf8'):'';const miss=[];const keys=r('lib/billing/pricing-keys.ts');const live=keys.slice(0,keys.indexOf('RETIRED_CATALOG_ITEM_KEYS'));if(/^\\s*'operator_seat',/m.test(live)||/operator_seat: \\{/.test(live))miss.push('operator_seat is still a live catalog item');if(!/'operator_seat',[\\s\\S]*?\\.\\.\\.RETIRED_ADDON_ITEM_KEYS/.test(keys))miss.push('operator_seat is not in the retired set');if(fs.existsSync('lib/billing/operator-seats.ts'))miss.push('operator-seats.ts still exists');if(fs.existsSync('app/(main)/spaces/[slug]/settings/billing/seat-editor.tsx'))miss.push('seat-editor.tsx still exists');if(/seatQuantity/.test(r('lib/billing/space-plan-checkout.ts')))miss.push('the loadout checkout still takes a seat quantity');if(/from: 'seats'/.test(r('lib/pricing/pricing-grid.ts')))miss.push('the pricing grid still sells seats');if(/'catalog_operator_seat_active',/.test(r('lib/pricing/settings.ts')))miss.push('the seat flag is still a pricing flag');if(miss.length){console.error('LIVE-993: '+miss.join('; '));process.exit(1)}"
